To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a portfolio in the evaluation of the students' learning in Physical Education is a good practice for the teacher to evaluate the students.
The two teachers used different approaches to evaluation, one focusing on the learning of the students and the other on the teaching and learning practices.
the teachers in our study have different approaches to assessment in PE, and that they use different assessment tools and methods to support their approaches.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the analysis of the practices of evaluation carried out by two Physical Education teachers in two different schools, in order to identify and discuss possibilities of evaluation practices in the context of the school.
a critical reflection about the practices of evaluation in Physical Education.
the possibility of inventing new practices of evaluation for Physical Education in school.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the evaluation practices in physical education are based on the teachers' own conceptions and on the specificities of the teaching and learning process.

the teachers' practices are not homogeneous and that the evaluation practices are diverse, being possible to find in their narratives, possibilities for a more critical, dialogical and democratic evaluation.
the teachers have different conceptions about evaluation, and this difference has to do with the way they conceive the practice of teaching.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is possible to invent possibilities for evaluation practices in physical education, based on the analysis of concrete experiences.
the evaluation practices of teachers are a reflection of their own conceptions about teaching and learning.
the teachers' narratives reveal the possibility to invent and use different instruments for the evaluation of learning in the school Physical Education class.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can use a wide range of methods to assess student learning.
we can learn a lot from the experiences of others, and that we should not be afraid to ask questions, to seek help, or to try something new, even if we are unsure about the outcome.
the evaluation of the students’ performance is an important tool for teachers in order to improve their teaching practice, and to understand the students’ knowledge, skills, and abilities.
